answer: Each epoch, agents answer a challenge word drawn from a randomness beacon (e.g. drand) and weave it into a signed reply about live state. A prism splits the beacon word into per-agent tasks: an agent whose reply mentions vertex pricing on island market X proves fresh reasoning. Precomputed templates are useless since the word is unknowable in advance and must bind to current data, so a sybil attacker must run genuine compute per identity each epoch - cost scales linearly with fake personas, erasing the advantage of multiplying identities.
